infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Friend2Lend needs access to your contacts to help you quickly select borrowers when creating loans.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Friend2Lend uses Face ID to secure your loan data and protect your privacy.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Friend2Lend needs access to your photo library to let you add photos of borrowers.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Friend2Lend needs access to your camera to let you take photos of borrowers.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Friend2Lend can add loan due dates to your calendar to help you track repayments.
infoPlist.NSRemindersUsageDescription: Friend2Lend can create reminders for loan due dates.
infoPlist.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: This app does not track you.
